Hessian.Goldstones: 12 zero eigenvalues are tangent to SU5/S(U3xU2); eaten by massive gauge bosons in gauged theory
Hessian.no_E6_completion: Spectrum applies to bosonic SU5 adjoint potential, NOT soft E6 full scalar spectrum or quantum-corrected masses.
Hessian.normalization: Hermitian adjoint Phi with 1/2 Tr(dPhi)^2 canonical kinetic; basis Tr(T_i T_j)=delta_ij

thermal_wall.Z2_sign_orbits: If Phi->-Phi is an exact GLOBAL Z2 and only this adjoint VEV selects the vacuum, the 3+2 and opposite 2+3 sign multisets are not SU5-conjugate.
thermal_wall.do_not_infer_transition_order: Gauge and bosonic loop cubic terms, daisy resummation and nonperturbative thermal effects can make the actual transition first order; mean-field threshold only.
thermal_wall.mean_field_addition: delta V = +c T² TrPhi²; c assumed positive and shape-independent
thermal_wall.quantum_physics_not_computed: This is a leading phenomenological thermal mass term, not the actual one-loop finite-T E6 action.
thermal_wall.restricted_one_component_kink_profile: f(z)=r tanh(sqrt(2g)*r*z) with g=lambda+7kappa/30; Phi=f(z) diag(2,2,2,-3,-3)/sqrt30
thermal_wall.tension_is_upper_bound: A nontrivial multidimensional wall path may have smaller tension; if Z2 is explicitly broken, stable walls need not exist.
